cand.title: ALEGRO Workshop 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong official event evidence and credible scientific/education demand mechanism; venue commitment prevents treating it as open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Marlene Turner (CERN), 2027 chair, and Edda Gschwendtner (CERN), 2027 co-chair, are verified organizer-side relationship contacts. Their relevance is workshop oversight and referral to the housing/logistics decision-maker, not proven purchasing or contract-signature authority. Brigitte Cros and Patric Muggli are also listed 2027 co-chairs. The official event inbox is alegro.2027@cern.ch; the published accommodation execution channel is housing.service@cern.ch. No named 2027 housing procurement manager was established.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: ALEGRO Workshop 2027, 2 March 2027 12:00 to 4 March 2027 12:00, Europe/Zurich. These are workshop activity dates, within the requested horizon. The accommodation form covers 1–5 March, not the scientific programme. No officially announced 2028 edition was located; do not extrapolate dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional lodging/relationship prospect, not the primary 2027 meeting venue. Its Founex location is separate from the CERN Meyrin campus. Scientific delegates needing off-site accommodation could be relevant only if the organizer confirms unmet demand and a workable paid/group transfer plan. No Founex transfer or YOTEL booking evidence was found. Current attendance is unpublished; the 2024 limit of 100 participants is historical capacity, not a 2027 forecast. Neither a 20–120-room block nor whole-house demand is established. Future small workshops or working-group retreats could fit the supplied meeting product, but this is a proposed use case, not an announced requirement. Resort positioning is not the demand driver.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially listed venue: CERN, room 31/3-004 – IT Amphitheatre, Meyrin, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory classification: Geneva Airport-side/Meyrin corridor, not Geneva city centre, Founex/Nyon/La Côte or Lausanne. This is a published venue commitment, not evidence of a signed contract or an open meeting-venue requirement.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: ANAR2017 at CERN; 26–29 March 2018 Oxford, Denys Wilkinson Building, with accommodation/meals at Somerville College; 26–29 March 2019 CERN Main Auditorium; 22–24 March 2023 DESY Lecture Hall, Hamburg; 19–22 March 2024 IST Anfiteatro Abreu Faro, Lisbon; 4–6 March 2025 SLAC Kavli Auditorium; 3–5 March 2026 INFN-LNF Auditorium B. Touschek, Frascati; announced return to CERN in March 2027. The 2023 page explicitly records a four-year hiatus. Recent consecutive editions do not establish an uninterrupted annual recurrence or a fixed Geneva rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific sourcing is established: CERN Housing Service / CERN Hostel (Building 39 reception), with a pre-booked group allocation covering 1–5 March 2027. Exact quote: “Booking requests will be treated according to the availability on the group booking. If all the pre-booked rooms have been used, booking requests will be treated according to the hotel availability.” Participants return the form to housing.service@cern.ch at least 31 days before expected arrival. Published single room with bathroom: CHF 62 per room/night. Allocation size, take-up and room nights are not published. No external commercial hotel is named in the retrieved 2027 materials, and no open RFP or external overflow allocation is evidenced. This is not an assertion that all attendees must stay on site. Historical hotels must not be treated as 2027 inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: ALEGRO is the Advanced Linear Collider Study Group, an international scientific study group. The 2026 report describes workshops organized by the ICFA-ANA panel and a local organizing committee; CERN hosts the 2027 edition and supplies named chairs and accommodation infrastructure. Treat as research-institution/scientific-network demand, not a verified incorporated trade association or corporate event agency. No appointed PCO, DMC or external housing bureau was identified in the retrieved edition-specific material.
findings.competitiveLimitations: CERN already provides the meeting room and a CHF 62 single-room hostel pathway. Inference: on-site convenience and that published rate are material competitive hurdles for off-site Founex accommodation. The 2027 form specifies fallback to hotel availability after the pre-booked allocation is used; it does not establish external overflow or a sell-out. In 2019 CERN also blocked hostel rooms. Historical external sourcing existed elsewhere: 2024 negotiated Hotel Alif Avenidas and Hotel Alif Campo Pequeno; Hotel Açores (Hotel Bensaude) and Hotel TURIM Alameda were additionally suggested. The 2025 SLAC Guesthouse block was 20 rooms; Leland Hotel Palo Alto, Comfort Inn Palo Alto, Coronet Motel, Glass Slipper Inn and Hotel Parmani were recommendations, not evidenced blocks. None is a 2027 incumbent external hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact alegro.2027@cern.ch for Marlene Turner and Edda Gschwendtner, acknowledging the CERN venue and hostel allocation. Ask who owns external accommodation referrals, the allocated/remaining hostel rooms, out-of-block room demand, nightly pattern and budget, and whether any external hotel arrangement is permitted. Request an introduction to CERN Housing Service rather than claiming the chairs control lodging contracts. Only if unmet off-site demand exists, offer a small non-exclusive YOTEL lodging proposal with costed transfers and flexible release terms; do not assume a 20-room minimum. Separately ask how hosts and venues for later working-group meetings/editions are selected. No speculative room hold or venue-replacement pitch.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 scientific meeting placement is already assigned to CERN and accommodation has an incumbent CERN group-booking route. Do not qualify as open hotel sourcing. External lodging remains unverified rather than impossible; no evidence supports an accessible YOTEL block, displaced delegates, or off-site dinner purchase. Published transport guidance describes airport/public-transport access to CERN and says the CERN shuttle is not operating; it does not establish a hotel transfer service from Founex.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain a low-priority relationship-development track for incremental 2027 off-site rooms only after a real gap is confirmed, plus later CERN-hosted working groups or a future Geneva-area edition. International institutional rotation and the documented hiatus prevent assuming an annual local opportunity. No 2028 venue/date or competitive hotel tender was located. Future hotel-based meeting capture would require a new organizer decision, not displacement of an allegedly uncommitted 2027 venue.
